### 2026-11-02: In this session, I made all of the test programs to make sure that all of the components in my project are working and I made most of the main program for the Weather Display. I used a little AI to un

**0.1h**

In this session, I made all of the test programs to make sure that all of the components in my project are working and I made most of the main program for the Weather Display. I used a little AI to understand how everything worked and would fit together, but most of the code was me.

First, I made the test programs. This took me a little while because I had to learn how everything worked from AI and then make it. I made test programs to make sure the board firmware was installed properly, the OLED was working properly, and to make sure Wi-Fi could connect properly.

Then, I made most of the main program. For the setup, I could mainly just copy paste it from the test programs, but I had to rewrite all of the code for the main loop and write the functions to get weather from API keys. I still have to handle Wi-Fi reconnecting and import the icons needed.

### 2026-11-03: In this session, I first made more parts of the code in the main program and then went on to debug for most of the time.

**0.1h**

In this session, I first made more parts of the code in the main program and then went on to debug for most of the time.

First, I made some more of the code. I realized that I would have to add Wi-Fi reconnecting in order for this to work properly, so I did that. I also made some elaborate try blocks to handle the errors.

Second, I debugged my code. I had to go through a few cycles of ask AI, fix the problems, ask AI, fix the problems just to get them narrowed down. There are still a few left. I was mainly working on getting the try blocks to work the way I wanted them to, but I also added more error handling for the API keys and for drawing the icons.
